_comment: Spec §7 labelled set: hand-verified (rawTitle, channel, runtimeMin) -> tconst pairs. Verified by looking each film up in the IMDb datasets DIRECTLY and confirming year and runtime, never by accepting what the resolver returned — a set generated from resolver output would measure the resolver against itself. 25 of the 41 (61%) are from the non-English channels, which are the cases the resolver is least able to self-check. runtimeDeltaPct is (upload - IMDb)/IMDb and is recorded so a weight change that moves a band shows up here as a named film rather than a count.
_sequels: The Crazy Companies pair is deliberate and was a bug in the first draft of this file: a LIKE on the English title matched the SEQUEL upload while it was labelled with the base film tconst. Both are here now, 97m against 99m and 98m, one minute apart with the same year — which is the case §2 keeps trailing roman numerals for. Any change that starts matching one to the other will fail here rather than in the catalogue.
_rejected: Six candidates were dropped during verification rather than guessed at, and the reason the set is hand-made: Prehistoric Women (upload 73m sits between the 1950 film at 74m and the cut release of the 1967 Hammer film at 91m), Her Sister from Paris (upload 99m against IMDb 70m — silent-era framerate, not a match error), War and Peace Part One (147m against IMDb 373m for the complete cut, which trips the split-upload reject by design), and the 2004 HK film Blood Brothers (IMDb carries no aka under that name). Operation Y and The Irony of Fate have no exact index hit at all and are left out for the same reason.
